retailers.name: Mercury
retailers.notes: Website terms clause 3.4 prohibits scraping/mining; clause 3.1 restricts image reproduction. Flex Rates page provides periods and eligibility, not a complete numeric regional import tariff. No automated collector enabled.

retailers.name: Contact Energy
retailers.notes: Public help explains network and meter-dependent pricing. No complete applicable nonpersonal tariff obtained in this research. Never use ICP query parameters or personalised quote flows.

retailers.name: Genesis Energy
retailers.notes: Official FAQ says rates depend on region and meter. Product page had no readable pricing in the research tool; this is not evidence that public rate cards never exist.

retailers.name: Meridian Energy
retailers.notes: Public plan comparison links to a quote flow. Export buy-back rates and promotional credits are not complete household electricity import tariffs.

retailers.name: Electric Kiwi
retailers.notes: Public pricing page asks for an address. Website terms restrict public copying and redistribution. No address was entered and no price was imported.

retailers.name: 2degrees
retailers.notes: Public page describes bundled broadband/power with address entry in the broadband flow. Marketing discount percentages are not a full electricity tariff.
